notes: bf16_mfma is NOT the raw measurement. rocprofiler-compute reported MFMABF16Flops at 618889190000000, which is 1.987x below MFMAF16Flops, but gfx950 runs both at the same matrix-core rate -- the knowledge base lists them as one entry, 'FP16/BF16 2.5 PF'. The raw figure is a tool artifact, not a property of the chip, and a ceiling divided by it comes out roughly twice as loose as it should, which reads as a bf16 kernel being twice as close to its ceiling as it is. The value here is the measured fp16_mfma rate; see source_by_figure.bf16_mfma.

int8_mfma measured at 1232292600000000, which is 1.996x below fp8_mfma -- the same halving signature the bf16 column showed. The value here is the raw measurement and has NOT been substituted: unlike FP16/BF16, no vendor statement says gfx950 runs int8 MFMA at the fp8 rate, so correcting it would be a guess. If a ceiling for an int8 matrix kernel looks twice as loose as it should, this figure is the first thing to re-measure.

bf16_valu measured at 6.7x below fp16_valu, which is neither 1x nor the 2x halving signature and has no explanation here. It is left at the measured value. A vector-bf16-bound kernel -- elementwise or activation work kept in bf16 -- would get a loose ceiling from it, so prefer fp16_valu as the proxy and say so if a case depends on this figure.

No transcendental roof is carried: rocprofiler-compute's roofline measures none and the knowledge base states none. Price softmax, exp, tanh, rsqrt and sigmoid against the vector roof, which bounds what the SFU can retire, and record that the substitution makes the ceiling loose.
Measured with the card in SPX compute partition and NPS1 memory partition at a 1400 W cap. A differently partitioned or power-capped MI355X will not match these figures.

fp8_mfma and mxfp8_scaled_mfma share one measured column, as do the fp4/fp6 paths and their scaled twins: gfx950 runs the scaled variants on the same matrix cores, at the rate set by the widest operand.

source_by_figure.bf16_mfma: rocprof-compute --roof-only, column MFMAF16Flops (substituted for MFMABF16Flops, which read 618889190000000 -- 1.987x low, a known tool artifact on 3.4.0; gfx950 runs bf16 and fp16 MFMA at one rate)
source_by_figure.dispatch_floor_s: graph-replay probe, 200 dispatches per capture, minimum of 25 rounds after 500 warmup; the same batch timed eagerly came to 4.4739e-06 s, 2.885x higher, which is host submission a graph-timed driver never pays
